package.name: system_logger
package.description: Terminal sink for /system/log: every pipeline node (module_integrate_node, r2lp1_planning_node, ...) publishes its own JSON status/metric line here instead of managing its own log file. Parses each line, echoes a human-readable version to the console (and optionally a file), and periodically logs a rolling summary (per-node event counts, worst-case latency/sync-error fields) so pipeline health can be read off one topic.
